tex_content.html:
Lemma
[convexity of forward directions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0067 ↗ def:chow-ii-forward-track-direction 1. ch10:10.60\group Convex geometry

If every $\mathcal J(t)$ is convex, then $D_{(V,t)}\mathcal L$ is convex.
Proof

\sketch Take approximating vectors for two directions and form their convex combinations; convexity of $\mathcal J(t+h_i)$ gives the required approximation.

□
